title: U.S. Justice Department Targets Medical Clinics in Federal Transgender Child Care Probe - NewsBreak
text: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The Department of Justice announced Wednesday, July 9, 2025, that it has issued more than 20 subpoenas to medical professionals and clinics across the country who are involved in performing transgender medical procedures on children. The announcement came from Washington and was shared by the agency’s Office of Public Affairs. According to the Department, the subpoenas are part of a broader investigation into potential healthcare fraud, the issuing of false statements, and other violations related to gender-related medical care provided to minors. Federal officials are focusing their scrutiny on whether any illegal activity occurred in the treatment practices offered by these clinics and physicians. “Medical professionals and organizations that mutilated children in the service of a warped ideology will be held accountable by this Department of Justice,” said Attorney General Pamela Bondi in a statement released from Washington. Her comment underscores the Justice Department’s intent to investigate not only the medical practices themselves, but also the motives and ideologies driving them. Though the names and locations of the specific clinics have not been officially disclosed, sources close to the matter told reporters that many of the subpoenas target clinics in major metropolitan areas.
